version.changelog:
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- No changes to the core functionality or documentation in SKILL.md.

llm.summary: This skill is a narrow prompt-only code review helper for trimming over-engineered diffs, with no executable code or hidden access requests.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the artifact: it instructs the agent to review diffs for unnecessary complexity and produce terse findings.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly limits itself to over-engineering and says correctness, security, and performance are out of scope, so users should not treat it as a full review.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The installed artifact is a single non-executable SKILL.md file; no scripts, dependencies, hooks, or bundled tools are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions only require reading a user-provided diff and writing review comments; there is no request for filesystem mutation, network access, credentials, or broad local data access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background execution, privilege escalation, credential/session/profile use, or automatic actions are described.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a terse review pass focused only on deleting unnecessary complexity. Use a normal review as well for bugs, security, performance, and maintainability issues outside that narrow scope.
